answers.explanation: Clusters are loosely coupled machines; multiprocessors are tightly coupled CPUs.
A SAN lets many machines reach the same storage.
High availability is the main reason to build a cluster.
It's idle capacity waiting for a failure.
No node sits idle in standby.
The program has to be split into pieces that run on different nodes at once.
A node takes a lock before touching shared data, and others wait.
They're loosely coupled: separate machines with their own memory and OS.
